name: Brand expressive
summary: Big display type, vivid color and springy motion, for launches that must be remembered.
description: Brand expressive is an Open DS scheme: a full set of answers to the Open DS grammar, with the reasons behind each, usage rules, voice and tone, and the tokens that follow. Big display type, vivid color and springy motion, for launches that must be remembered.

ai.use_when: Launch sites, campaigns, marketing pages and consumer brands that lead with personality.
ai.avoid_when: Tools people use for hours, or forms where calm matters more than character.

scenarios.text: A visitor lands on a launch page from a social post and joins the waiting list.
An agency swaps the campaign colors for the next drop without changing the components.

summary.text: Playful and short. Big words, few of them.

principles.text: Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
Playful in headlines, plain in errors.

inventory.description: The components this system carries, picked from the grammar catalogue by the components answers. Anything not listed is out.

in.why: The waitlist form over the page.
A product preview that opens on tap.
Confirms a place on the waitlist.

out.why: Campaign pages tell a story; they do not list records.
Launch sites have no app navigation.
Visitors on phones do not use keyboard menus.
Campaign sections show everything; nothing worth saying is hidden.
Hover never happens on a phone, where most visitors arrive.

samples.description: Sample content for showing this system: written from its use scenarios, in its voice, with every status mapped to a meaning. Storybook, the site and the docs read it; it is never shared between schemes.

usage.use: Button primary, large, one per section

The alternative must not compete.
Confirm before destroying data.
A word keeps it clear.

usage.use: The closest semantic token, then ask for a new one
usage.not: A raw value in the component
usage.why: The next campaign changes primitives; raw values would stay behind.

usage.use: A short verb that moves: Join, Try, Go
usage.why: Big moments need verbs with energy.

usage.use: Plain first, a light touch after
usage.why: Playful copy must never hide what went wrong.

usage.why: A short celebration is remembered.

color.$description: Colour options: raw hue ramps. Each hue has a light ramp, a dark ramp (the same steps tuned for dark backgrounds) and its base value (@, built as color.<hue>). Themes pick from these; components never read them.

taupe.$description: The taupe hue: a light ramp, a dark ramp and its base value.

pink.$description: The pink hue: a light ramp, a dark ramp and its base value.

green.$description: The green hue: a light ramp, a dark ramp and its base value.

amber.$description: The amber hue: a light ramp, a dark ramp and its base value.

red.$description: The red hue: a light ramp, a dark ramp and its base value.

black.$description: See-through black for scrims behind dialogs, light and dark.

space.$description: Space options. Names give the size in pixels at the default text size; values are rem.

size.$description: Size options for controls, rows and icons.
Type size options. Names are pixels at the default text size; values are rem, so text grows with the user's setting.

1_05.$description: A ratio of the text size.

1_1.$description: A ratio of the text size.

1_2.$description: A ratio of the text size.

1_3.$description: A ratio of the text size.

1_4.$description: A ratio of the text size.

1_55.$description: A ratio of the text size.

family.$description: Font family options. Each brand's theme picks its display, body, interface and data fonts from these.

fast.$description: Fast: the usual convention for feedback, about 120ms.

moderate.$description: Moderate: a calm, easy-to-follow speed, about 200ms.

relaxed.$description: Relaxed: a slower, springy speed for expressive motion, about 320ms.

shadow.$description: Raw shadows. Elevation semantics point at these.

card.$description: Raw shadow for card in light mode.

overlay.$description: Raw shadow for overlay in light mode.

card-dark.$description: Raw shadow for card in dark mode.

overlay-dark.$description: Raw shadow for overlay in dark mode.

default.label: Brand expressive
default.description: The single brand: vivid magenta, Bricolage Grotesque display, pill controls.

theme.$description: The Brand expressive theme: what each brand-dependent semantic key picks, in light and dark, plus mode-free picks (fonts, corners) in base.

default.$description: Height of buttons and inputs, and the smallest target.

container.$description: Corner of cards, menus and dialogs.

scrim.$description: Dims the page behind a dialog.

focus-ring.$description: Focus ring color on any button.

icon-size.$description: Size of an icon inside a button.

checked.$description: Fill of a checked checkbox or an on switch.

background.$description: Fill of a dialog, menu or toast.

scrim.$description: Color that dims the page behind a dialog.

content.$description: Voice tokens: the words components use for common actions. Text, not CSS.

commit.$description: The label of the action that completes a task.

cancel.$description: The label of the way out next to the main action.

destroy.$description: The label of an action that deletes data.

retry.$description: The label that repeats a failed action.

empty-action.$description: The label of the action in an empty state.
